en./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistBowDesc: Narin's signature bow is the north wind's icy messenger. Alt Fire unleashes a charged blizzard arrow that freezes enemies it touches and leaves behind a chilling path.
en./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistPistolsD: Narin's signature pistols strike with winter's bite. Reloading sends out a chilling pulse that inflicts Cold Status Effect, the pulse's range increases with each round reloaded.
en./Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCorufellDesc: Corufell Prime's golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.
en./Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSteflosShotg: This rose has gilded thorns. Deal death from even further afar with Citrine Prime's signature shotgun.

zh./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistBowDesc: （英文：NUNCHASA）Narin 的标志性弓箭是北风的冰霜使者。次要开火模式会释放一支充能暴雪箭，冻结接触到的敌人并留下一道寒冰的痕迹。
zh./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistPistolsD: （英文：AKSONDOL）Narin 的标志性手枪威力十足，如同凛冬的寒风。每次装填都会释放出一道寒冷的脉冲，使敌人陷入冰冻异常状态，脉冲的范围会随着装填次数的增加而扩大。
zh./Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCorufellDesc: （英文：CORUFELL PRIME）闪劫 Prime 的金色藤蔓让变形更流畅，使重击更迅捷。
zh./Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSteflosShotg: （英文：STEFLOS PRIME）带有镀金棘刺的玫瑰。通过这把 Citrine Prime 的标志性霰弹枪，从更远的地方施展致命一击。

provenance.applicability: Pinned Update 44 resources only; not asserted to match subsequently collected PublicExport.
